faq: Which state management do you work with?
Whatever your app already uses, including Provider, Riverpod, Bloc and GetX. We do not swap it out unless you order a refactor. New code follows your existing patterns so your team can maintain it.
What if my Flutter version is old?
We build with the version your project uses. If a feature needs a newer Flutter or Dart version, we tell you and suggest an upgrade, which may be priced as a maintenance task.
Can you write native code when a plugin is missing?
Yes, when a feature needs it, such as a special Bluetooth device. We write small Kotlin and Swift pieces behind a platform channel and test both. This stays within the scope we confirm.
Invite us to your Git repository with limited rights and send the build steps. We never need your store passwords for feature work, and we never push to your main branch.
